basis: April 30, 2025 is the earliest qualifying disclosure I could verify. Tennant’s consolidated GAAP net sales for the three months ended March 31, 2025 were $290.0 million, down 6.8% from $311.0 million a year earlier and $5.45 million below the $295.45 million cutoff. I recovered Tennant’s March investor deck and Sidoti’s March 19 schedule. Neither establishes what management said at the separately announced March 20 CL King event. Its public status and contents remain unverified, so the earliest date remains unresolved.

coverage.detail: October 31, 2024, Q3 release. The $1.280–$1.305 billion net-sales range covered fiscal 2024. It supplied no Q1 2025 ceiling.
November 1 Q3 call, third-party transcript. Management discussed the 2025 effects of backlog normalization without giving a numeric Q1 2025 consolidated sales forecast.
November Baird conference. Tennant’s 28-page presentation repeated the fiscal 2024 outlook on slide 23. No Q1 2025 reported-sales ceiling was identified.
February 17, 2025, Q4 release. Both the $1.210–$1.250 billion net-sales forecast and the 1%–4% organic decline applied to full-year 2025. The release supplied no quarterly upper bound.
Tennant’s event page confirms the February 18 earnings call at 9 a.m. Central and links the webcast and slides.
The issuer-linked Q4 webcast returned a cache miss. I could verify the slides and consult a third-party transcript, but could not authenticate a replay through this endpoint.
February 18 issuer slides. The sales guidance covers full-year 2025. The presentation gives no numeric Q1 reported-sales range.

February 18 call, third-party transcript. At 26:57 the CFO discussed seasonal Q1 and Q3 volume. At 29:51 the CEO identified two separate hosts and dates, Sidoti on March 19 and CL King on March 20. Neither remark quantified Q1 sales.

Recovered Tennant’s full March 2025 investor deck. Its financial chart labels $1.235 billion as estimated 2025 net sales and identifies that estimate as the annual guidance midpoint. The 3%–5% organic sales growth target is long term. The deck supplies no Q1 2025 reported-sales ceiling and does not document the March 20 remarks.

Sidoti’s own March 18 schedule, distributed via Nasdaq, lists Tennant on Wednesday, March 19 from 12:15 to 12:45 p.m. Eastern. Although Sidoti’s conference continued on March 20, Tennant’s listed slot was March 19.
Tennant-specific webinar link from Sidoti’s schedule. The redirect returned a cache miss. No host recording or transcript was recovered through it.

March 19 Sidoti remarks, third-party transcript. The CEO quantified the 2024 backlog reduction at roughly $125 million and discussed expected 2025 order growth. Neither provides a numeric ceiling for consolidated Q1 2025 sales.

CL King’s own calendar rendered its Past Events heading with no entries. Searches for Tennant, TNC, the date, a webcast and a roadshow located the February announcement but no March 20 agenda, recording, transcript, event-specific deck or confirmation of a private-only format.
The host’s direct Tennant search was inaccessible.
The attempt to retrieve a contemporaneous copy of CL King’s calendar was also inaccessible.

Tennant’s archived-events page rendered a year selector without historical entries. Targeted issuer-site and SEC exhibit searches yielded no March 20 event record or interim Q1 sales update. The supplied 8-K inventory identified no intervening earnings exhibit.
April 17 issuer notice scheduled results for after the April 30 market close and the call for May 1. It contained no preliminary sales figure.

April 30 actuals. Both periods appear on the same consolidated net-sales line. Tennant reconciled the 5.0% organic decline, a positive 0.3% acquisition effect and a negative 2.1% currency effect to the reported 6.8% decline.
The subsequent Form 10-Q confirms consolidated net sales of $290.0 million and $311.0 million for the March 2025 and March 2024 quarters, respectively.

publication_date_evidence: Tennant’s IR release displays 04/30/2025. The SEC-hosted Exhibit 99.1 carries an April 30 Minneapolis dateline and states that Tennant reported the March-quarter results that day. This establishes the actuals’ publication date. The March 20 CL King evidence gap prevents certification that April 30 was first.
